create_agent_for_worker: create an Agent for a worker to work on a given Unit via Agent.new(db, worker, unit)
get_agent_status: get the current status of an Agent by calling agent.get_status() to check their work progress
update_agent_status: update an Agent's database status by calling agent.update_status(new_status) to transition their state
get_live_update: get a live update from an Agent's frontend by calling agent.get_live_update(timeout) to receive pending actions
create_onboarding_agent: create an OnboardingAgent for a worker via OnboardingAgent.new(db, worker, task_run) for onboarding tasks
